Lance Stroll's teammates in the provided results include Sebastian Vettel (Aston Martin, 2021, Document 4) and Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin, 2023 and 2025, Documents 6 and 5). Nico Hülkenberg (Racing Point, 2020, Document 8) also appears as a teammate, but he never won a championship.

The documents don't state championship counts, so this part comes from my general knowledge rather than the sources. Vettel won four drivers' titles (2010–2013) and Alonso won two (2005, 2006), all within 2000–2025. Sergio Pérez and Felipe Massa, who were also Stroll's teammates in other seasons, never won a championship.

ANSWER: Sebastian Vettel, Fernando Alonso
